text_en: I love the Lord , because he has heard my voice and my supplications.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 我对上主爱慕倾心， 因他俯听我的祷声；

text_en: Because he inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
text_cn: 在我呼吁他的那日， 他向我侧他的圣耳。

text_en: The snares of death encompassed me; the pangs of Sheol laid hold on me; I suffered distress and anguish.
text_cn: 死亡的圈套缠住了我， 阴府的罗网缚住了我， 艰苦和烦恼困住了我，

text_en: Then I called on the name of the Lord : “O Lord , I pray, save my life! ”
text_cn: 我呼求了上主的圣名， 上主，求你救我的性命。

text_en: Gracious is the Lord , and righteous; our God is merciful.
text_cn: 上主富有怜悯和正义， 我们的天主仁爱无比；

text_en: The Lord protects the simple; when I was brought low, he saved me.
text_cn: 上主保护诚朴的人， 我若软弱，他必救助。

text_en: Return, O my soul, to your rest, for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you.
text_cn: 我的灵魂，你回到你的安息， 因为上主实在是厚待了你。

text_en: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
text_cn: 因为他救拔了我的灵魂脱免死亡， 不使我的眼流泪，不使我的脚跌伤。

text_en: I walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
text_cn: 我要在活人的地域， 在上主的面前行走。

text_en: I kept my faith, even when I said, “I am greatly afflicted”;
text_cn: 虽然说我已痛苦万分， 但是我仍然抱有信心。

text_en: I said in my consternation, “Everyone is a liar. ”
text_cn: 我在彷徨中曾说： 众人都虚诈不诚。

text_en: What shall I return to the Lord for all his bounty to me?
text_cn: 我应该要怎样报谢上主， 谢他赐给我的一切恩佑？

text_en: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord ,
text_cn: 我要举起救恩的杯爵， 我要呼吁上主的名号，

text_en: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people.
text_cn: 我要在众百姓面前， 向上主还我的誓愿！

text_en: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his faithful ones.
text_cn: 上主的圣者们的去世， 在上主的眼中十分珍贵。

text_en: O Lord , I am your servant; I am your servant, the child of your serving girl. You have loosed my bonds.
text_cn: 我的上主！我是你的仆役， 你仆役是你婢女的儿子； 你将我的锁链给我开释，

text_en: I will offer to you a thanksgiving sacrifice and call on the name of the Lord .
text_cn: 我要献给你赞美之祭， 我要呼号上主的名字。

text_en: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,
text_cn: 我要在众百姓面前， 向上主还我的誓愿，

text_en: in the courts of the house of the Lord , in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 要在上主圣殿的庭院， 耶路撒冷！即在你中间。
